# infoBAG

> > Technical knowledge base covering embedded systems (RK3588, RockChip), API development (Fusio), command-line tools (feed2exec, restic), and software engineering practices.

infoBAG is a personal technical documentation site maintained as a knowledge repository. It focuses on practical guides for embedded Linux systems, automation tools, API integration, and software development workflows, with particular emphasis on RK3588/RockChip hardware customization and Python-based utilities.

## Key Topics

- RK3588 embedded systems
- RockChip hardware customization
- feed2exec RSS processing
- Fusio API framework
- Python automation tools
- NPU driver configuration
- maildir and email tools (Offlineimap, Dovecot)
- AoT prompt engineering
- Flask deployment
- Backup strategies (restic, tar, zstd)
- X Window System configuration
- GitHub repositories
- Command-line utilities
- Android device rooting
- Software architecture patterns

## Embedded Systems & Hardware

- [RK3588 Customization](https://ib.bsb.br/rk3588-customization): RK3588 VPC-3588 embedded system customization and U-Boot management guide
- [rk3588 npu](https://ib.bsb.br/rk3588-npu): RK3588 NPU driver management and hardware acceleration configuration guide
- [RockChip devices](https://ib.bsb.br/rockchip-devices): RockChip rk3066 Android device rooting and firmware customization guide

## API Development & Integration

- [Creating APIs to Integrate tools and workflows using Fusio](https://ib.bsb.br/creating-apis-to-integrate-tools-and-workflows-using-fusio): Fusio API creation tutorial for workflow automation and service integration
- [deploying Flask applications on DirectAdmin](https://ib.bsb.br/deploying-flask-applications-on-directadmin): Flask deployment guide using Nginx Unit on DirectAdmin hosting

## Command-Line Tools & Automation

- [feed2exec](https://ib.bsb.br/feed2exec): RSS feed processing tool with maildir storage and filtering examples
- [backup bash script](https://ib.bsb.br/backup-bash-script): Bash backup script using tar, zstd compression, and USB storage utilities
- [Copy Spotter and Duplicate-File-Remover](https://ib.bsb.br/dup-spotter): Duplicate file detection tools with content hashing and similarity scoring

## AI & Prompt Engineering

- [AoT prompt enhancer](https://ib.bsb.br/aot): AoT framework for LLM prompt engineering and optimization with SMART criteria
- [AGENTS.md](https://ib.bsb.br/agentsmd): Documentation template and agent instructions for content generation

## Software Engineering & Architecture

- [How to write complex software](https://ib.bsb.br/how-to-write-complex-software): Software architecture methodology using layered design and abstraction

## System Configuration

- [X](https://ib.bsb.br/x): X Window System xorg configuration with ratpoison and key bindings setup
- [Helium Browser](https://ib.bsb.br/helium): Helium Browser installation script for Debian 11 ARM64 with GPU config

## Optional

- [Pragmatic Guide to Parenting](https://ib.bsb.br/pragmatic-parenting): Self-directed education and alternative parenting guide by John Taylor Gatto
- [Abril 2021](https://ib.bsb.br/abril-21): April 2021 Brazilian stock portfolio performance and investment tracking
